## Session A · 2:05–3:15

What is random and what is not. Residuals and errors; sampling variation; what a standard error is a statement about; where p-values come from and what they are not. How sample size, and how much the explanatory variable actually varies, move standard errors

## Session B · 3:35–4:30

Simulation lab: draw from a world you control, watch the p-value distribution under the null, then change the sample size and the variation and watch it move. Nothing to install, no code to write
